test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The poor fellow was laughed at by the crowd.

options.text: The crowd was laughed at the poor fellow.
The crowd had laughed at the poor fellow.
The crowd is laughed at the poor fellow.
The crowd laughed at the poor fellow.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The crowd laughed at the poor fellow."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Passive Voice. It is in Simple Past Tense.
 
• As per the given question, we must change it to Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• In active voice, the subject **(the crowd)** performs the action **(laughed)**.
 
• **"The crowd" **is the subject of the sentence, so we can make it the doer of the action by placing it before the verb **"laughed".**
 
• The sentence in active voice becomes: *"The crowd laughed at the poor fellow."*
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
